name: nuttx_current_task

ownership.argument: Borrowed current TCB pointer. Read only on the current task to establish its TLS default-loop identity; never retain the task/group pointer.

provenance.source: Exact-image 0x0C4C61C0 and 0x0C4C5980 load current TCB from 0x201738F8; TLS at TCB+68, group at TCB+8. See astrolink/docs/evidence/p65-loop-ownership.md.

notes: Exact P65 owner-task identity only. No runtime approval or general foreign task/group pin.
